result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with multiple lanes, resulting in a long and exposed crossing distance for pedestrians. Although sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the crosswalk markings are faded and the pavement is in poor condition, indicating a lack of prioritized pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven road surfaces could pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and intersection center

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk but no signalized control or pedestrian refuge. The environment is characterized by long crossing distances and a lack of physical protection for pedestrians crossing high-speed traffic lanes.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds at an unsignalized crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Warning Signage
hazards.description: There are no visible signs warning drivers of the upcoming pedestrian crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadside approaches to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of marked crossings, sidewalks, or signals. The wide roadway and sweeping curb radii suggest a high-speed vehicle environment with very long unprotected crossing distances.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross this wide, multi-lane intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: High-speed geometry
hazards.description: The wide, sweeping curve for right-turning traffic encourages high vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the road curves

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway forces pedestrians to remain in the path of traffic for an extended period without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: The span of the roadway from the foreground to the opposite side

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete absence of visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals. The wide roadway geometry and lack of dedicated pedestrian space create significant exposure risks for anyone attempting to navigate the area on foot.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or marked crossings visible, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground along the roadway edges.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane intersection creates a very long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
